raw_site_text: nationwide Community-Driven Development program in rural villages of The Gambia; six rural Local Government Areas; excludes Banjul and the Kombo area in the West Coast Region
justification: Randomly allocated nationwide CDD program in rural villages across the six rural LGAs, with the analysis sample restricted to above-median forest-cover wards (about half of rural villages).
note: Analysis sample excludes urban/peri-urban Banjul and Kombo and low-forest wards; no region other than West Coast (as an exclusion) is named, so nationwide rural is the best supported scope.
